tools.description: Load the shader preset at the given path.

preset.description: Path to a shader preset, absolute or under the shader directory. Empty turns the shader off.

tools.name: SET_SHADER

tools.description: Report whether content is playing or paused, with its system and the content's file name, or that no content is loaded.
tools.name: GET_STATUS

tools.description: Report an option's value, or list every option with its value.

option.description: An option name, as GET_OPTION with no argument lists.

tools.name: GET_OPTION

option.description: The option's name, as SET_OPTION takes it.

value.description: Its state - on or off - or, for one that only reports, what it reports.

tools.description: Turn an option on or off. Asking for the state it is already in changes nothing.

option.description: An option name, as GET_OPTION with no argument lists.

state.description: The state to put it in.

tools.name: SET_OPTION

tools.description: Report the lines RetroArch has logged since the given line, then where to ask from next time (next), and how many of the lines asked for were already gone (skipped).

since.description: The first line wanted, as NEXT gave it; 0 when left out.

tools.name: GET_LOG

next.description: The line to ask for next, as GET_LOG's since takes it.

skipped.description: Lines that were asked for but had already left the log.

tools.description: Pause and advance the content by the given number of frontend frames, excluding speculative replay calls; finish paused. Over MCP one request runs nine seconds of frames at most (540 at 60fps), as PRESS, RUN_UNTIL and STEPS do.

count.description: How many frames to run; ask again to run more.

tools.name: RUN_FRAMES

value.description: What the byte holds, in decimal from 0 to 255, or none where nothing maps it now.

tools.description: Hold RetroPad buttons or stick axes for the core, over the player's own input, until set again or released. Answers with the player, the buttons held and the axes held, none for either where nothing is.

control.description: A RetroPad button or stick axis, or several joined by "+" to hold together: b, y, select, start, up, down, left, right, a, x, l, r, l2, r2, l3, r3, left_x, left_y, right_x, right_y. "right+a" runs and jumps in one request.

value.description: 1 holds a button and 0 lets it go; an axis takes -32768 to 32767, 0 letting it go.

tools.name: SET_INPUT

axes.description: The axes held, as name=value separated by spaces, or none.

buttons.description: The buttons held, separated by spaces, or none.

player.description: The player the controls are held for, from 1.

tools.description: Press RetroPad buttons for some frames and let go, in one request; with until, run on until a condition holds. What SET_INPUT holds stays held. Answers with what WATCH watches; the content finishes paused.

control.description: A RetroPad button, or several joined by "+": b, y, select, start, up, down, left, right, a, x, l, r, l2, r2, l3, r3. "right+a" runs and jumps.

frames.description: Frames to hold them. A tap is 2 to 4; hold longer with SET_INPUT.

until.description: Then run until this holds, as RUN_UNTIL's: "1d == 0" lands a jump.

tools.name: PRESS

met.description: With until: frames run until it held.

tools.description: Run the content until memory meets a condition, in one request rather than running frames and reading again. Answers with the frames run - met, or waiting: ask again - what WATCH watches and the value.

address.description: A system address in hexadecimal, as GET_MEMORY_MAP gives them; high:low, such as 6d:86, reads two bytes as one value.

condition.description: How it compares with the value.

frames.description: Frames to wait at most; as many as a request runs when left out.

value.description: What to compare it with: 0 to 255, or 0 to 65535 for high:low.

tools.name: RUN_UNTIL

met.description: The frames run until the condition held.

value.description: What the memory waited on holds now.

waiting.description: The frames run without it meeting it; ask again to wait more.

tools.description: Run a stretch of play - approach, jump, land - in one request. Answers done, waiting (time ran out: ask again from step) or stopped, with the frames run, what WATCH watches and the step it ended on.

steps.description: In order, separated by ";": run <frames>, press <player> <controls> <frames>, until <condition> as RUN_UNTIL's, and one stop <condition> that ends the list where it holds: "until 86 >= 200; press 1 a 20; until 1d == 0; stop e == 11".

tools.name: STEPS

step.description: The step it ended on, from 1.

waiting.description: Frames run before time ran out.

tools.description: Watch bytes at system addresses under labels, so RUN_FRAMES, PRESS, RUN_UNTIL and STEPS answer with them and a step needs no reads after it. With none, answers what is watched and what each holds now, in decimal. 16 at most; cleared when content closes.

watches.description: Labels and system addresses in hexadecimal, as GET_MEMORY_MAP gives them, in pairs: "x 86 mode 770" on a NES, "x 7e0086" on a SNES. A label already watched is replaced, and off for its address stops watching it. 16 at most.

tools.name: WATCH

tools.description: Let go of everything SET_INPUT holds, for one player, or every player when given none. Answers as GET_INPUT does, for that player or the first.

player.description: The player, from 1; every player when left out.

tools.name: RELEASE_INPUT

tools.description: Report what a player holds, without changing it: SET_INPUT has to set something to answer and RELEASE_INPUT lets go before it does.

player.description: The player, from 1; the first when left out.

tools.name: GET_INPUT

tools.description: List the running core's options: key, value and description; with a key, that option with the values it takes.

option.description: A core option key, as GET_CORE_OPTION with no argument lists it.

tools.name: GET_CORE_OPTION

description.description: What the option is called in the menu.

key.description: The option's key, as SET_CORE_OPTION takes it.

values.description: The values it takes, separated by "|"; given only where the option was asked for by key.

tools.description: Set a core option to one of its values. Asking for the value it already has changes nothing.

option.description: A core option key, as GET_CORE_OPTION with no argument lists it.

value.description: One of the values GET_CORE_OPTION with the key lists.

tools.name: SET_CORE_OPTION

tools.description: List the installed cores: name and the path LOAD_CONTENT takes. With a content path, only the cores that support it.

content.description: A content path. Left out, every installed core; given, only the cores that support it.

tools.name: LIST_CORES

path.description: The core's path, as LOAD_CONTENT takes it.

tools.description: List the playlists, as GET_PLAYLIST takes them.
tools.name: LIST_PLAYLISTS

playlist.description: The playlist's name, as GET_PLAYLIST takes it.

tools.description: List a playlist's entries: index, label, content path and core path, 200 at a time, and where to go on from when there are more.

first.description: The entry to start at; the first when left out.

playlist.description: A playlist name as LIST_PLAYLISTS gives it, ".lpl" and all.

tools.name: GET_PLAYLIST

next.description: The entry the next page starts at, as GET_PLAYLIST's first takes it.

content.description: The content's path, as LOAD_CONTENT takes it.

core.description: The core's path, as LOAD_CONTENT takes it; empty where the playlist names none.

index.description: The entry's number in the playlist.

tools.description: Show a message on screen.

message.description: The text to show on screen.

tools.name: SHOW_MSG

tools.description: Read bytes from core memory at a system address. Answers with the address and the bytes, in hexadecimal.

address.description: The address to read from, in hexadecimal.

bytes.description: How many bytes to read, a count.

tools.name: READ_CORE_MEMORY

tools.description: List the core's memory map: a region's start, length, select and disconnect are hexadecimal, as READ_CORE_MEMORY takes them.
tools.name: GET_MEMORY_MAP

access.description: rw, ro, or none where the core exposes none.

select.description: Which address bits name the region.

space.description: What the core calls the address space, or empty.

tools.description: Write bytes to core memory at a system address. Answers with the address and how many bytes were written.

address.description: The address to write to, in hexadecimal.

bytes.description: The bytes to write, in hexadecimal, separated by spaces.

tools.name: WRITE_CORE_MEMORY

tools.description: Save a state to a slot, or load the one in it.

action.description: Save to the slot, overwriting it, or load from it, replacing the game state.

tools.name: STATE

tools.description: Play, seek, record, halt or checkpoint a replay.

action.description: Play the replay in a slot, seek the playing one to a frame, record one to the current slot, halt playing or recording, or add a checkpoint to the one recording.

number.description: The slot to play, or the frame to seek to.

tools.name: REPLAY

tools.description: Load a core library, start it without content, or unload it.

action.description: Load a core library, start the loaded one without content, or close the content and unload the core.

core.description: load: the path, as LIST_CORES gives it.

tools.name: CORE

tools.description: Load the content at the given path with the core at the given path, or with a core that supports it where the core path is DETECT or empty.

content.description: Path to the content, as GET_PLAYLIST gives it.

core.description: Path to the core to load it with, as LIST_CORES and GET_PLAYLIST give it; DETECT, as a playlist entry with no core of its own gives it, picks a core that supports the content.

paused.description: on: pause once it has loaded, before it runs on, so nothing happens before the first step.

tools.name: LOAD_CONTENT

tools.description: Close the running content.
tools.name: CLOSE_CONTENT

tools.description: Restart the video or audio driver, or all drivers.

driver.description: Which driver, or all of them.

tools.name: REINIT

tools.description: Press a menu button: move, confirm (a) or back (b).
tools.name: MENU

tools.description: Eject or insert the virtual disc, or select the next or previous disc image.

action.description: Eject or insert the disc, or select the next or previous image.

tools.name: DISK

tools.description: Quit RetroArch.
tools.name: QUIT

tools.description: Reset the running content.
tools.name: RESET

tools.description: Take a screenshot.
tools.name: SCREENSHOT
